# Assess and operate packaging producer responsibilities

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

## Outcomes

- A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Map packaging activities and market data

agent-runnable


Collect the selling entities, destination markets, packaging materials and weights, brand ownership, imports, supply activities and relevant financial periods. Separate estimated quantities from measured records and identify supplier-data gaps.

- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine producer status and local obligations

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The environmental-compliance owner reviews the actual market, producer role, group structure and current eligibility rules. Determine applicable registration, data, reporting, recycling and fee duties; do not apply one country assessment to every sales destination.

- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the packaging data and reporting controls

agent-runnable


Build the material and activity schedules under the reviewed classification instructions. Reconcile supplier records, packaging specifications and sales data; document allocation methods, uncertain measurements and the owners of recurring data collection.

- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the registration and compliance route

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The accountable compliance owner approves the applicability determination, any scheme appointment, required registration and reporting calendar. Obtain specialist review of disputed status or categories before authorizing an external declaration or payment.

- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Complete approved registrations and reports

human · human approval required · irreversible


An authorized operator submits the reviewed registrations and packaging reports and arranges approved fees or scheme work through the applicable route. Retain acceptance, rejection and payment evidence; submission or scheme membership alone does not prove every obligation is complete.

- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Reconcile receipts and reassess changes

agent-runnable


Match reported amounts and payments to the approved data, preserve the calculation trail and assign corrections. Calendar reporting and source reviews and reopen the determination when packaging, volumes, markets or group facts change.

- Verify: A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.
- Sources: [GOV.UK packaging EPR applicability](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-you-must-comply-with-epr-for-packaging--2)
